messages.content: Explain what a REST API is in simple language.

messages.content: Explain SQLite WAL mode in plain language.

fresh_answer: SQLite WAL mode writes changes to a log so reads and writes can work more smoothly.

messages.content: Explain rate limiting in an API.

fresh_answer: Rate limiting controls how often clients can call an API to protect reliability.

messages.content: Explain idempotency in software.

fresh_answer: Idempotency means repeating the same operation has the same effect as doing it once.

messages.content: Describe idempotent behavior in software systems.

fresh_answer: Idempotent behavior means repeated identical operations produce the same result.
